generate_gibson_large_dataset: run the script to generate customized Gibson training splits for the PointNav task with quality threshold filtering
generate_pointnav_episodes: create PointNav navigation episodes for a given scene using the habitat simulator and episode generator
filter_scenes_by_quality: build a filter to select Gibson scenes with reconstruction quality above a specified threshold from dataset statistics
safe_mkdir: create a directory safely without raising an error if the directory already exists
compress_dataset_to_json_gz: summarize the generated PointNav dataset episodes and write them to a gzip-compressed JSON file
